# Support

Netrune 8.5 supports current Linux distributions and WSL2 with Python 3.11 or
newer. macOS is experimental. Windows without WSL2 is not supported.

Use the documentation and issue tracker for installation, compatibility, and
reproducible defects. Include `netrune version`, the device family and firmware,
the command used, and a redacted `netrune support bundle` when relevant. Never
attach secrets or unreviewed production evidence.

Vendor support is capability-specific. A detected vendor name does not imply
that every firmware release or command is supported. See
`docs/device-support.md` for the advertised matrix and evidence gates.

This project is community-maintained and provides no emergency response or
service-level agreement.
